analysis.reasonEn: Shifted to sell from a 3-day consecutive wait-and-see stance. RSI at 39.5 continues in oversold territory, and MACD histogram at -6.0413 confirms worsening momentum. The 5-day low of $330.98 was breached, reinforcing a Lower High pattern. Weekly RSI at 44.0 and weekly MACD histogram at -8.3091 maintain a bearish trend. ADX at 16.4 indicates a non-trending phase, but the -DI (29.2) exceeding the +DI (20.5) suggests downward pressure dominance. The 4-hour RSI at 35.5 and MACD histogram at -14.4659 echo the bearish signals from the daily chart.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($332.73) vs SMA5 ($370.85)/SMA20 ($381.85)/SMA50 ($377.90): Below moving averages, confirming short-to-medium term bearish position.
· Significantly below SMA100 ($413.57)/SMA200 ($399.92): Indicating weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (36.2%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (67.1→39.5): Continues in oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (11.7219→-6.0413): Bearish trend persists, with increased downward pressure after a death cross.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $311.91): Approaching the lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance ($365.90): First resistance zone for any short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Lower High formation + 5-day low breached): Reinforcing the downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.96x): Moderate confidence in current price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Confirmed by persistent oversold RSI and worsening MACD, meeting sell entry conditions.
